projects.name: AquaSense
projects.title: AquaSense — On-Premise Water Monitoring and Control
projects.summary: On-premise IoT operations platform for telemetry, alarms, device provisioning, acknowledged commands, audit records, and role-based control.
projects.problem: Water monitoring and relay control need a trusted local workflow where telemetry, device identity, commands, acknowledgements, and operator actions remain visible.
projects.outcome: Designed a coarse-grained on-premise architecture that keeps device identity, telemetry, command acknowledgement, privileged access, and operational state explicit.
proof_points: Sanitized architecture and device-to-dashboard flow documented as a public case study
Command lifecycle distinguishes request, delivery, acknowledgement, resulting state, and timeout
Deployment and commissioning boundaries are stated instead of presented as completed production work
feature_deep_dives: Telemetry Ingestion and Device Identity Boundary
limitations: Release-candidate software still requires target-server validation, company PKI, firewall review, backup testing, and device commissioning.
Relay coil voltage, socket, driver circuit, load behavior, and fail-safe wiring must be verified before hardware commissioning.

projects.name: InternLog AI
projects.title: InternLog AI — Internship Documentation Workspace
projects.summary: Internship workflow product connecting daily logs, weekly logbooks, controlled AI review, document readiness, and export preparation.
projects.problem: Internship records are often scattered across daily notes, weekly reports, evidence files, and final-document requirements.
projects.outcome: Built a traceable workflow where daily records become reviewed weekly outputs and AI suggestions remain optional, bounded, and user-approved.
proof_points: Daily records remain the source of truth for downstream documents
AI-assisted review is separated from factual records and requires user approval
Document readiness exposes incomplete, stale, and blocked areas before export
feature_deep_dives: Daily Log to Weekly Logbook Lifecycle
Controlled AI Mentor and Recommendation Flow
limitations: Multi-user support remains a limited beta rather than a commercial SaaS release.
File evidence and larger document assets are still handled outside Firestore to stay within the intended free-tier architecture.

projects.name: AI Content Strategy
projects.title: AI Content Strategy and Decision System
projects.summary: Public decision-support application that generates multiple content strategies, validates structured model output, compares trade-offs, and recommends an execution path.
projects.problem: Many AI content tools return one answer without making trade-offs or selection logic visible.
projects.outcome: Implemented a typed Next.js and Gemini workflow with runtime guards, normalized result states, three strategy variants, scoring, recommendation, fallback behavior, and risk notes.
proof_points: Public source is pinned to commit d3aedfd1dc8e76a29bf51a14fc12da4a77219de0 in the case-study evidence record
Runtime type guards validate decision, previous-strategy, and legacy response shapes before rendering
The API normalizes model output and exposes comparison, recommendation, execution, validation, and risk fields
limitations: Model output still requires human judgment.
Heuristic scoring is not a substitute for real campaign measurement.

projects.name: FormAI
projects.title: FormAI — AI Form Automation Platform
projects.summary: AI-assisted Google Form automation platform with form analysis, deterministic CSV mapping, AI fallback, validation, execution modes, and row-level diagnostics.
projects.problem: Repeated Google Form submission is slow, inconsistent, and risky when many respondents, rules, or answer sources are involved.
projects.outcome: Designed an operator-facing workflow where users can analyze a form, prepare structured data, preview mapping, execute safely, and inspect what happened per row.
proof_points: Analyze-first workflow before execution
Deterministic CSV mapping before AI fallback
Dry-run preview before mutating submission
Duplicate guard and row-level diagnostics
Fast HTTP mode plus browser execution mode
feature_deep_dives: Deterministic CSV Mapping and AI Fallback
limitations: The form must be analyzed again when its structure changes.
Some forms still require browser execution instead of the faster HTTP submission path.

projects.name: Smart Clothesline IoT
projects.title: Smart Clothesline IoT System
projects.summary: Realtime dashboard for sensor telemetry, clothesline state, automation rules, alerts, history, and operational diagnostics.
projects.problem: Weather-sensitive device control needs visible telemetry, automation state, alerts, and safe fallback behavior.
projects.outcome: Built a web dashboard around MQTT telemetry, Firebase state, notifications, automation rules, and operating documentation.
proof_points: Realtime telemetry summary
Heartbeat and stale-state monitoring
Automation thresholds and schedules
limitations: Realtime reliability depends on network and device health.
Safety state must remain clear when sensor input is uncertain.

projects.name: Polinema Adaptive TOEIC
projects.title: Polinema Adaptive TOEIC — Adaptive Micro-Learning Platform
projects.summary: Responsive TOEIC micro-learning platform with institutional roles, research cohorts, content workflows, assessments, deterministic mastery updates, and research exports.
projects.problem: A campus learning pilot needs more than exercises: it also needs identity, consent, cohorts, controlled content, assessment evidence, and research-ready exports.
projects.outcome: Built a release-candidate platform covering student, lecturer, administrator, and validator workflows with PostgreSQL-backed learning and assessment data.
proof_points: Server-side RBAC and NIM/NIP authentication
Assessment autosave, scoring, mastery, and deterministic recommendations
Research cohort, consent, freeze, and anonymous CSV export
Versioned content and expert validation workflow
Local verification, backup, restore, and production runbooks
limitations: Production SMTP, institutional SSO or SIAKAD integration, and centralized object storage are not yet integrated.
The current status is a pilot-operations release candidate, not an institution-wide production rollout.

projects.name: OrthoBreath
projects.title: OrthoBreath — PKM-KC 2026 Health-tech Prototype
projects.summary: Prototype dashboard for child profiles, dental capture, breathing-session monitoring, scan history, notifications, and combined reporting.
projects.problem: Screening-related records can become fragmented when profile data, dental observations, breathing sessions, and reports are handled separately.
projects.outcome: Prepared a Next.js frontend with Firebase-backed user and patient records and an API-ready service boundary for future model integration.
proof_points: Parent and child profile flow
Dental and breathing history structure
Combined report service contract
limitations: Prediction behavior remains mock-first until model integration and validation are completed.
The prototype does not make a clinical accuracy or medical-device readiness claim.
